description: This file defines the internal class StreamSubscriptionManagerAdmin, which implements the IStreamSubscriptionManagerAdmin interface. It manages a specific StreamSubscriptionManager instance and provides access to it based on a string identifier, primarily handling explicit subscription management within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: StreamSubscriptionManagerAdmin
classes.description: An internal class that manages stream subscription managers, providing access based on subscription type.

methods.name: GetStreamSubscriptionManager
methods.description: Returns the stream subscription manager corresponding to the specified manager type, or throws an exception if not found.
